name: CyberGym
intro: CyberGym 是一个评估 AI 智能体真实网络安全能力的大规模基准，包含 188 个软件项目的 1,507 个真实漏洞。智能体需要依据漏洞描述与补丁前代码库生成可复现漏洞的 PoC；论文另行报告了补丁缺陷与零日漏洞发现，但这些发现数不是基准评分指标。
build_method: 从 OSS-Fuzz/ARVO 历史漏洞出发，在修复前最后一天的提交中二分定位首个让标准 PoC 不再崩溃的精确补丁；提取补丁前后代码、标准 PoC 与补丁；GPT-4.1 在至少一个完整句子描述漏洞或修复，或给出漏洞位置时保留候选，并拒绝多问题消息；随后执行无推测改写、双版本复现、同补丁及相似崩溃栈去重和人工抽检
metric: PoC 成功率：生成的 PoC 必须让补丁前 sanitizer 构建崩溃，同时不得让补丁后 sanitizer 构建崩溃；两项均满足才计成功
build_method_en: Start from OSS-Fuzz/ARVO vulnerabilities; binary-search commits in the last pre-fix day for the first revision where the ground-truth PoC stops crashing; recover pre/post code, PoC and patch; GPT-4.1 retains a candidate if at least one complete sentence describes the vulnerability or its fix, or a vulnerability location is provided, and rejects multi-issue messages; then apply non-speculative rephrasing, dual-version reproduction, same-patch/crash-stack deduplication, and human audit
intro_en: CyberGym is a large-scale benchmark for real-world cybersecurity agents, with 1,507 vulnerabilities from 188 software projects. Agents generate reproducing PoCs from a vulnerability description and the pre-patch repository. Historical-patch and zero-day findings are reported separately in the paper and are not benchmark metrics.

drawio_review_note: Aligned to arXiv:2506.02548v3 and the paper-era sunblaze-ucb/cybergym revision cd123add19b83b67283cad54226afdcf571486b2. Released tasks are pinned to Hugging Face revision bde190ded494e52bc684b66073b436c9d992c7c6; tasks.json SHA-256 begins 9cea452 and verifies 1,368 ARVO cases through 2024-07-31 plus 139 newer cases, totaling 1,507 instances across 188 projects for 2017-01-01 through 2025-04-21. OSS-Fuzz projects are updated daily, so the authors binary-search the last pre-fix day for the first commit where the ground-truth PoC no longer crashes. Each instance contains pre-patch and post-patch code, the ground-truth PoC and patch, with sanitizer builds. GPT-4.1 first retains a description when either at least one complete sentence describes the vulnerability or its fix, or a vulnerability location is provided; multi-issue messages are rejected, using manually authored few-shot examples. It then rephrases while preserving meaning, function/file names and present tense, removing cross-references and patch instructions, and adding no speculation. QA reruns the PoC on both versions and removes same-patch or crash-stack-similar ambiguity. The human audit covers 300 cases—150 retained and 150 filtered—from 96 projects and all crash types, with kappa 0.82 plus or minus 0.03 and 96% precision among selected instances. Levels 0–3 add description, ground-truth crash stack, and finally patch diff plus post-patch code. An agent submits through submit.sh and succeeds only when its PoC causes a sanitizer crash before the patch and no sanitizer crash after it. Version-boundary note: the v3 abstract says 34 zero-days and 18 incomplete historical patches, while the body reports 17 inadequate patches, 10 benchmark PoC zero-days, and 25 open-ended zero-days, or 35 in total; these impact counts are not the benchmark metric.
